question: Is the sum of the decimal digits of 2^116 equal to 166?

claims.text: 2^116 is about 8.3 × 10^34 and so has 35 digits.
A digit sum near 166 is plausible for a 35-digit number, given an average of about 4.7 per digit.
166 ≡ 4 (mod 9), so the digit sum is consistent with the mod 9 check.
The mod 9 check cannot confirm 166 on its own, because many other values are also congruent to 4 mod 9.
Direct computation, not the mod 9 check, is what decides the question.
The recalled value of 2^120 was not independently verified, which is the main residual risk.
